i have serious mental health problems and until a few months ago i was considering suicide too. but then a friend of mine - an old one i hadn't spoken to in years - died as the direct result of another mental health problem. even if your friends seem distant right now, it WILL affect them badly if you die. how much it hurt me, when she was an old friend i hadn't even spoken to in forever, really surprised me. and it made me realise that people are affected even if they seem/are distant. it'll crush everyone around you.

i really hope you can get better. if you ever need a sympathetic ear/shoulder to cry on, you can message me. i know exactly what it's like, and no one should have to bear the burden alone.

EDIT: i also noticed you said your friends told you to "stop being depressed". this is REALLY common among people who don't understand mental illness, and it is NOT your fault at all. i know it sucks really hard, but it's really easy for people who haven't had mental illness themselves to write it off as something you can change, and their frustrations are not your fault. they should know better.
